title: 第5章：回家
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
另一边。

    如果说现代到处是高楼大厦和车水马龙，那么80年代便是低矮平房，以及乡土气息。

    “爸，饭煮好了，等凉一会了，我喂你吃。”

    女孩小小的身子，将一碗热气腾腾的稀粥端到男人面前，准确说，是放在床旁边的破木箱子上。

    这是马超的二妹，名叫马娟，今年只有10岁，像其她这么大的孩子全在上学，而马娟却在家里洗衣做饭，还要照顾小她4岁的弟弟马强，和2岁大的妹妹马莉。

    王素琴离开的这两年，马超既当爹又当妈，他是所有弟弟妹妹的好兄长，好大哥，因为父亲马建业要赚钱养家，根本顾不上家里。

    原本以为，马娟年纪大点了，如今也能帮着家里分担点家务，这样马超可以和马建业一块赚钱养家，日子会一天天好起来，人也就有了盼头。

    可谁曾想，麻绳专挑细处断，厄运专找苦命人……

    家里的顶梁柱倒下了，马超要赚钱养家，马娟要照顾弟弟妹妹，现在还多了一个马建业。

    小小的肩膀上，有太多她这个年纪本不应该有的东西。

    马建业看着稍显稚嫩的二女儿，眼眶红红的，“娟儿，你和强子，还有莉莉去吃，爸不饿。”

    “爸，你都快一天没吃东西了。”

    “强子他能自己吃，莉莉那边，过一会了我去喂她吃。”

    “二姐不用，我能照顾好妹妹。”

    6岁大的马强一下子从椅子上站起来，拍着那有些干瘪的胸口，信誓旦旦，一副小大人的口吻。

    这一幕，落在马建业眼里，既有心酸，还有一丝安慰，他努力扯动嘴角，挤出笑容，“我家强子长大了，是个小男子汉。”

    “嗯，我是小男子汉，大哥是大男子汉。”

    马娟看向马建业，“爸，你就别找借口了，大哥走的时候专门叮嘱我，让我看着你好好吃饭。”

    “呵！这臭小子，现在都开始管起老子来了。”

    “爸！大哥也是为了你好，大哥说了，只有好好吃东西，你的腿才能好起来。”

    马建业苦笑一声没反驳，但他心里清楚，八百块家里拿不出来。

    即使马超从王素琴那里要回玉佩，估计玉佩顶多能卖一两百。

    和手术费的八百元相比，杯水车薪，还有药钱，后续康复治疗的费用，在80年代，这就是一笔巨款！

    马建业现在想的就是，还不如干脆死了一了百了，这样他能给大儿子减轻一些负担。

    他这辈子，最对不起的就是马超和马娟，小小年纪承担了太多，如果还有下辈子，他还想做两人的父亲。

    ……

    与此同时。
content_en:
other side.

    If modern times are full of high-rise buildings and busy traffic, then the 1980s were all about low-rise bungalows and a rustic atmosphere.

    "Dad, the rice is ready. Let it cool for a while, then I'll feed it to you."

    With her small body, the girl brought a bowl of steaming gruel to the man. To be precise, she placed it on the broken wooden box next to the bed.

    This is Ma Chao's second sister, named Ma Juan. She is only 10 years old this year. While other children her age are all in school, Ma Juan does laundry and cooking at home, and also takes care of her 4-year-old brother Ma Qiang and her 2-year-old sister Ma Li.

    In the two years since Wang Suqin left, Ma Chao has been both a father and a mother. He is a good brother and a good eldest brother to all his younger brothers and sisters, because his father, Ma Jianye, has to make money to support the family and cannot take care of the family at all.

    I originally thought that Ma Juan was older and could now help the family with some housework, so that Ma Chao and Ma Jianye could make money to support the family. Life would get better day by day, and people would have hope.

    But who would have thought that hemp ropes only break at the thinnest places, and bad luck only seeks out the miserable...

    The mainstay of the family has fallen. Ma Chao has to make money to support the family, Ma Juan has to take care of her younger siblings, and now there is another Ma Jianye.

    There are too many things on her small shoulders that she should not have at her age.

    Ma Jianye looked at the slightly immature second daughter with red eyes, "Juan'er, you and Qiangzi and Lily go to eat. Dad is not hungry."

    "Dad, you haven't eaten for almost a day."

    "Qiangzi can eat by himself. Lily, I will feed her after a while."

    "You don't have to, second sister, I can take good care of my sister."

    Six-year-old Ma Qiang suddenly stood up from his chair, patted his somewhat shriveled chest, and swore with the tone of a young adult.

    This scene, in Ma Jianye's eyes, was both sad and a little comforting. He tried hard to twitch the corners of his mouth and squeeze out a smile, "My Qiangzi has grown up and is a little man."

    "Well, I'm a little man, and my eldest brother is a big man."

    Ma Juan looked at Ma Jianye and said, "Dad, please stop making excuses. When my eldest brother left, he specifically told me to watch you eat well."

    "Ha! This brat is starting to take care of me now."

    "Dad! Big brother is also doing it for your own good. Big brother said that only by eating well can your legs get better."

    Ma Jianye smiled bitterly and did not refute, but he knew in his heart that the family could not afford the eight hundred yuan.

    Even if Ma Chao wants the jade pendant back from Wang Suqin, it is estimated that the jade pendant can be sold for one or two hundred at most.

    Compared with the 800 yuan for the surgery, it was a drop in the bucket. There was also money for medicine and follow-up rehabilitation treatment. In the 1980s, this was a huge sum of money!

    What Ma Jianye thinks now is that he might as well die, so that he can relieve some of the burden on his eldest son.

    In his life, the people he feels most sorry for are Ma Chao and Ma Juan. He has shouldered too much at a young age. If there is another life, he still wants to be their father.

    ……

    at the same time.
